; PaperTerm runs outside the reMarkable interface, so its clipboard can't reach
; Notes. While an AppLoad window is open, this watches the file PaperTerm copies
; to and puts new text on the clipboard Notes pastes from. The clipboard is reached
; through a small object built at run time, so that if an OS update moves it, only
; this stops working and the window still opens.
AFFECT /appload/qml/window.qml
TRAVERSE FocusScope
LOCATE AFTER ALL
INSERT {
    Timer {
        id: paperTermClipboardBridge
        property bool started: false
        property string last: ""
        property var clipboard: null

        function receive(copied) {
            if(!started) {
                // Text from an earlier visit must not replace what is on the clipboard now.
                started = true;
                last = copied;
            } else if(copied != "" && copied != last) {
                last = copied;
                try {
                    if(!clipboard) {
                        clipboard = Qt.createQmlObject("import QtQml; import com.remarkable; QtObject { function set(text) { Clipboard.setTextFromString(text); } }", paperTermClipboardBridge, "paperTermClipboard");
                    }
                    clipboard.set(copied);
                    console.log("PaperTerm clipboard: passed on", copied.length, "characters");
                } catch(e) {
                    console.log("PaperTerm clipboard: failed:", e.message);
                }
            }
        }

        interval: 500
        repeat: true
        running: qtfbKey != -1
        triggeredOnStart: true
        onTriggered: {
            var request = new XMLHttpRequest();
            request.onreadystatechange = function() {
                if(request.readyState == XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                    paperTermClipboardBridge.receive(request.responseText);
                }
            };
            request.open("GET", "file:///tmp/paperterm-clipboard");
            request.send();
        }
    }
}
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
